info.title: School Management System API
info.description: Complete REST API for K-12 school management — 34+ route groups covering authentication, student/teacher/parent management, attendance, fees with wallet & balance sheet, exams with tabulation & position holders, homework diary, library with issue/return & fines, hostel, event calendar, alumni, parent-teacher conferences, approval workflows, teacher substitution, test management, timetable conflict detection, stock/POS, transport, admissions, leave management, SMS/WhatsApp/Telegram/Email notifications, AI assistant, real-time chat, analytics dashboard, PDF generation (report cards, fee receipts, certificates), CSV export, document uploads, audit logging, and more.
